notes.name: Necrozma
notes.desc: Necrozma se funde com Solgaleo (Dusk Mane, em Ultra Sun) ou Lunala (Dawn Wings, em Ultra Moon) pelo N-Solarizer ou N-Lunarizer, e vira Ultra Necrozma com o Ultranecrozium Z.

en.desc: Necrozma fuses with Solgaleo (Dusk Mane, in Ultra Sun) or Lunala (Dawn Wings, in Ultra Moon) using the N-Solarizer or N-Lunarizer, and becomes Ultra Necrozma with the Ultranecrozium Z.

notes.name: Poipole / Naganadel
notes.desc: O Poipole é presente da história e evolui para Naganadel subindo de nível com Dragon Pulse aprendido.

en.desc: Poipole is a story gift and evolves into Naganadel by leveling up while it knows Dragon Pulse.

notes.name: Ultra Beasts
notes.desc: A Ultra Warp Ride leva a todas as Ultra Beasts e aos lendários das gerações anteriores; a cor do buraco indica o que espera do outro lado.

en.desc: The Ultra Warp Ride leads to every Ultra Beast and to past-generation Legendaries; the wormhole's color hints at what waits on the other side.
